# Golden Peak — Private Tours & Airport Transfers in Almaty, Kazakhstan

> Golden Peak is a local tour operator based in Almaty, Kazakhstan. We offer private guided tours (priced per car, up to 4 people), airport transfers, and authentic food experiences for international travelers. All prices in USD.

## About

Golden Peak provides personalized travel services in Almaty, Kazakhstan's largest city. Founded by Nurzhan, a local guide born and raised in Almaty, we specialize in small-group private tours (priced per car, up to 4 people) with English-speaking guidance, comfortable transportation, and authentic cultural experiences. Golden Peak is a young, independent operator — we prefer to show honest information rather than fabricated reviews, and we welcome real feedback from guests after their tour.

- Website: https://goldenpeak.kz
- WhatsApp: +7-706-720-4680
- Location: Almaty, Kazakhstan
- Languages: English, Kazakh, Russian
- Operating hours: 08:00–22:00, 7 days a week
- Group size: private tours, up to 4 people per car

## Main Tours & Prices

### Charyn Canyon + Kaindy Lake + Kolsay Lake — $200 per car (up to 4 people)
Full-day private tour (10–12 hours) combining three of Kazakhstan's most iconic landscapes: the red rock walls of Charyn Canyon, the sunken forest of Kaindy Lake, and the turquoise waters of Kolsay Lake. Includes private SUV, English-speaking guide, national park entrance fees, and hotel pickup/drop-off. Up to 4 people per car.

### Golden Man Museum + Esik Lake + Turgen Waterfall — $150 per car (up to 4 people)
Full-day private tour (6–8 hours) mixing history and nature: the Golden Man (Saka warrior) museum, Esik Lake, and Turgen Waterfall. Includes private car, English-speaking guide, museum and park entrance fees, and hotel pickup/drop-off. Up to 4 people per car.

### Medeu + Shymbulak — $100 per car (up to 4 people)
Half-day private car transfer from your hotel to Medeu skating rink (world's highest-altitude rink) and Shymbulak ski resort, just outside Almaty. Driver only — no walking guide. Cable car tickets paid on site. Up to 4 people per car.

## Featured Package

### The Complete Almaty Experience — 3-Day Package — $450 per car (up to 4 people)
All three signature tours bundled into one all-inclusive 3-day package, plus round-trip airport transfer.
- Day 1: Charyn Canyon + Kaindy + Kolsay
- Day 2: Golden Man + Esik Lake + Turgen Waterfall
- Day 3: Medeu + Shymbulak
- Bonus: Round-trip airport pickup & drop-off

## FAQ

**Q: What tours are available in Almaty?**
A: Three main private tours, all priced per car (up to 4 people): Charyn + Kaindy + Kolsay ($200/car), Golden Man + Esik + Turgen ($150/car), and Medeu + Shymbulak ($100/car). Plus a 3-day all-inclusive package with airport transfer ($450/car), and custom tours on request — airport transfer, Kok Tobe, city walks, food tour, photography tours, and multi-day trips.

**Q: How much does a private tour in Almaty cost?**
A: All tours are priced per car (up to 4 people). Full-day guided tours: $150/car (Golden Man + Esik + Turgen) or $200/car (Charyn + Kaindy + Kolsay). The Medeu + Shymbulak transfer is $100/car (driver only). The 3-day all-inclusive package with airport transfer is $450/car.

**Q: How do I book a tour?**
A: Contact us via WhatsApp at +7-706-720-4680. We respond within 15 minutes.

**Q: Do you offer airport transfers?**
A: Yes. Round-trip airport transfer is bundled into the 3-day package, and standalone airport pickup or drop-off is available as a custom add-on — send your flight details on WhatsApp for a quick price.

**Q: Is the guide English-speaking?**
A: Yes, our guide speaks English and provides personalized service for international travelers.

**Q: What is included in the tour price?**
A: Full-day guided tours (Charyn + Kaindy + Kolsay and Golden Man + Esik + Turgen) include private car/SUV transport, English-speaking guide, hotel pickup and drop-off, and national park or museum entrance fees. The Medeu + Shymbulak tour is a private car transfer only (driver, no walking guide) — cable car tickets are paid on site. Food and personal expenses are not included unless stated otherwise.

**Q: What's the maximum group size?**
A: All tours are private with up to 4 people per car. You never share the vehicle with strangers.
